scope: fwp C library ownership, not an elapsed-time comparison with C or Rust. 256 repeated call batches after warmup; static or three dynamic load/unload executions. One retain is necessary for two independently released fields sharing one string. Retain counts exclude fresh count initialization and release work; input strings still copy. Shutdown counts exclude host memory, allocator capacity and operating-system RSS. The separate C/Rust interop programs use default library mode. Their host sizes reflect different runtimes and linkage, not a language size comparison. Instrumented binaries are inspected as data, never executed by this collector.
